pricing.subtitle: Access reserved for registered participants
pricing.description: A day to learn, share, and get inspired. Your ticket grants you access to the Engineers’ Gala, featuring conferences, exhibitions, discussions, and much more. This event is exclusively reserved for registered and confirmed participants.
pricing.note: A single ticket giving access to the full VIC experience, including talks, exhibitions, and networking spaces reserved for confirmed participants.

accueil.description: An exceptional evening to celebrate excellence and innovation in the field of engineering. Join us for an unforgettable day of networking, entertainment, and inspiration.

historique.title: Previous Editions
historique.subtitle: Engineers' GALA History
historique.description: Since its first edition, Engineers' GALA has established itself as an essential event for engineering in Algeria. Each edition is marked by quality conferences, prestigious guests, and a unique atmosphere of innovation and networking.

events.text: The first edition in 2017 marked the start of a tradition for the Vision & Innovation Club, an event symbolizing the meeting of elegance, excellence, and innovation.
The 2019 edition was a great success, with the Engineers Gala celebrating achievement. An evening marked by creativity and the strengthening of connections across generations.
The 2024 edition brought together 40 guests, 176 participants, 60 organizing team members, and 12 booths.

annee.title: This Year
annee.subtitle: 8th Edition
annee.description: For this 8th edition, we aim to go even further by offering interactive spaces, enriching conferences, and unique opportunities for students and young graduates.

cards.title: Startup Pitch
cards.text: A stage for young entrepreneurs and students to present their projects and ideas to a panel of experts, followed by an engaging open discussion and valuable feedback exchange.

cards.title: CV Review Corner
cards.text: A dedicated space for analyzing and advising on student CVs, led by professionals. A surprise awaits our guests on the big day.

cards.title: TED-Style Talks
cards.text: Dynamic 15 to 20-minute interventions led by speakers and experts on various themes related to innovation, technology, and personal development.

agenda.footer: Join us for a memorable day of innovation and networking

apropos.description: Founded in 2014 under the supervision of the 'EL-MAARIFA' association, the Vision & Innovation Club (VIC) is a scientific club active at the National Polytechnic School of Algiers.
